name: formalspecgen
description: Natural language to JML and verified Java with OpenJML diagnostics.

commands.title: Formal Spec: Verify with OpenJML ESC
Formal Spec: Verify with Automatic Boundary Routing
Formal Spec: Collect RAC Runtime Evidence
Formal Spec: Configure LLM API Key
Formal Spec: Verify Rust with Prusti

Formal Spec: Generate Domain Plugin Scaffold

formalspecgen.serverUrl.description: WebSocket URL of the backend when managed backend mode is disabled.

formalspecgen.manageBackend.description: Start the platform-native bundled backend and manage its lifecycle.

formalspecgen.managedPort.description: Loopback port used by the managed backend.

formalspecgen.toolManifestUrl.description: Optional HTTPS URL for a release tool manifest with pinned URLs and SHA-256 hashes.

formalspecgen.openjmlPath.description: Existing OpenJML executable; skips its managed download.

formalspecgen.dafnyPath.description: Existing Dafny executable; skips its managed download.

formalspecgen.tlcJarPath.description: Existing tla2tools.jar; skips its managed download.

formalspecgen.bootstrapPrusti.description: Install pinned Prusti and its Rust nightly on first use of the Rust target.

formalspecgen.prustiPath.description: Existing prusti-rustc executable; skips its managed download.

formalspecgen.kaniPath.description: Optional existing cargo-kani or kani-driver executable; skips the managed Kani download.

formalspecgen.framacPath.description: Optional existing frama-c executable; skips the managed Frama-C download where supported.

formalspecgen.formalspecDDRoot.description: Path to an optional legacy formalspecDD checkout used only by the compatibility handoff. Native implementation synthesis and deterministic postprocessing are bundled locally.

formalspecgen.formalspecDDPython.description: Python executable used only by the optional legacy formalspecDD compatibility handoff.

formalspecgen.rustupPath.description: rustup executable used to install Prusti's pinned nightly toolchain.

formalspecgen.provider.description: LLM provider used to draft specifications.

formalspecgen.ollamaBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible Ollama API base URL used by the managed backend.

formalspecgen.ollamaModel.description: Installed Ollama model used for drafting and refinement.

formalspecgen.llmTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum duration of one LLM request. Larger local Ollama models may need 600 seconds or more for TLA+ generation.

formalspecgen.safeRefactoring.description: Re-run impacted composition proofs when saved generated JML contracts change.

enumDescriptions: Require bounded architecture evidence, deductive proof, and reviewed boundary fallbacks.
Require static JML checking and RAC/JUnit runtime evidence; deductive proof is skipped.
Require compilation, specification linting, and ordinary runtime tests.
formalspecgen.assuranceLevel.description: Verification rigor. Relaxed profiles explicitly record skipped gates and never claim deductive proof.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run compile && npm run compile:e2e && node out/e2e/runTest.js
